items.distractor_fact: Комшија је истог јутра на свом термометру очитао {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: The neighbor read {D} °C on his own thermometer that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different person (the neighbor) reading his own thermometer, unlike the first distractor's different village (a place)

items.distractor_fact: Обвезница истог предузећа тог дана продавана је по {D} €.
items.gloss_en: Bonds of the same company were selling at {D} € that day.
items.entity_note: a different financial instrument (the company's bond), unlike the first distractor's different company (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: Републички хидрометеоролошки завод је за своју контролну тачку на суседном водотоку тог дана објавио ниво од {D} cm.
items.gloss_en: The National Hydrometeorological Institute published a level of {D} cm for its own monitoring point on a nearby watercourse that day.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (the Institute, owner of its own monitoring point), unlike the first distractor's different river treated simply as a place

items.distractor_fact: Други планинар се истог дана зауставио на висини од {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A different hiker stopped at an altitude of {D} m that same day.
items.entity_note: a different person (another hiker), unlike the first distractor's different mountain peak (a place)

items.distractor_fact: Његов саиграч је на крају те сезоне имао {D} kg.
items.gloss_en: His teammate weighed {D} kg at the end of that season.
items.entity_note: a different person (a teammate), unlike the first distractor's different gym (a place/instrument)

items.distractor_fact: Његов брат је истог дана уплатио {D} $ на сопствени рачун.
items.gloss_en: His brother deposited {D} $ into his own account that same day.
items.entity_note: a different person (his brother), unlike the first distractor's separate account at the same bank (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: Осигуравајуће друштво је за то путовање наплатило премију од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: An insurance company charged a premium of {D} $ for that trip.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (an insurance company), unlike the first distractor's travel companion (a person)

items.distractor_fact: Независни књиговођа је за другог клијента тог месеца обрачунао трошак од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: An independent bookkeeper calculated a cost of {D} $ for a different client that month.
items.entity_note: a different person (an independent bookkeeper), unlike the first distractor's different store in the chain (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: Инвестициони фонд је на сличној позицији истог дана забележио губитак од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: An investment fund recorded a loss of {D} $ on a similar position that same day.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (an investment fund), unlike the first distractor's different investor (a person)

items.distractor_fact: Друга производна линија у истом погону произвела је {D} комада тог месеца.
items.gloss_en: A different production line within the same plant produced {D} units that month.
items.entity_note: a different instrument/unit of production (a separate line), unlike the first distractor's different factory in the concern (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: Регионални менаџер је за свој округ у истом периоду забележио продају од {D} $.
items.gloss_en: A regional manager recorded sales of {D} $ for his own district in that same period.
items.entity_note: a different person (a regional manager) with his own unstated sales target, unlike the first distractor's different store in the chain (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: Метеоролошки институт је за сопствену мерну мрежу тог месеца објавио {D} mm падавина.
items.gloss_en: The Meteorological Institute published {D} mm of rainfall for its own measurement network that month.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (the Institute) with its own unstated forecast, unlike the first distractor's neighboring town (a place)

items.distractor_fact: Аутобуска линија на истој релацији тог дана забележила је долазак у тренутку који је, рачунајући од поноћи, износио {D} минута, према сопственом реду вожње.
items.gloss_en: A bus line on the same route recorded an arrival that, counted from midnight, came to {D} minutes that day, according to its own timetable.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (a bus company) with its own unstated timetable, unlike the first distractor's different train and line (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: Управа суседне зграде утврдила је да се други лифт зауставио на спрату означеном бројем {D}, према сопственој нумерацији.
items.gloss_en: The management of a neighboring building determined that a different elevator stopped at a floor numbered {D}, according to its own numbering.
items.entity_note: a different organisation (the building's management), unlike the first distractor's different building's elevator (a place/instrument)

items.distractor_fact: Приватни улагач је у истом кварталу остварио добит од {D} $ на сопственом портфолију.
items.gloss_en: A private investor earned a profit of {D} $ on his own portfolio in the same quarter.
items.entity_note: a different person (a private investor), unlike the first distractor's third company Gama (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: На стази другог такмичења, одржаног истог викенда, постигнуто је време од {D} s.
items.gloss_en: On the track of a different competition, held the same weekend, a time of {D} s was recorded.
items.entity_note: a different place (another competition's track), unlike the first distractor's third runner Jovanović (a person)
